Name: Dynamic Flooring - Continued
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn/about-me?gameId=1303]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14780]Dynamic Flooring[/url] mod.


This mod works with flooring samples that you buy from Robin, but instead of applying them to predetermined static areas in specific
decoratable locations, you can apply them anywhere you like.


[size=5][b]Applying[/b][/size]

To apply custom tile areas:

[list]
[*]Have the farmer hold the flooring sample
[*]Hold down the mod button (default [b]Left Control[/b])
[*]Move the cursor to the tile to begin on
[*]Press and hold the place button (default [b]Mouse Left[/b])
[*]Drag the cursor to the tile to end on
[*]Release the place button
[/list]
There will be a translucent green rectangle over the affected tiles as you drag.


[size=5][b]Removing[/b][/size]

To remove a custom tile area:

[list]
[*]Move the cursor to a tile in the custom tile area
[*]Press the remove button (default [b]Delete[/b])
[/list]

[size=5][b]Ignoring[/b][/size]

To ignore flooring placement restrictions, hold down the ignore button (default [b]Left Shift[/b]) when placing.

This allows you to place flooring anywhere on any location.

Ignoring restrictions also ignores existing floor tiles when determining which
tile to place - this is meaningful for flooring with multiple different
tiles. When ignoring restrictions, tiles are chosen based on their
position within the custom area.

Note that this can lead to non-floor tiles being floored, so you may have to floor an area
piece-by-piece to avoid, for example, placing floor tiles on walls.


[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

By default, flooring is not consumed when applied using this mod. You can change that in the config.

This mod doesn't mess with the game's existing flooring, so you can safely remove this mod without issues.

As of SDV 1.6, now includes fix for spouse rooms/cellar stairs disappearing when removing flooring placed with this mod in the farmhouse/cabins. Previously needed my Farmhouse Fixes mod to fix the issue but no longer necessary.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods[/url].
